listing.name: Food Commodities
listing.summary: Adding food items to the game for base factions
listing.aiSummary: Adds faction-based food dishes, collectable items, and production/consumption structures to enhance immersion.

description:
Food Commodities

Adding food items to the game for base factions

Download here

Github Repo

What this mod includes

- 5 Faction based food dishes. (For now)
- 1 Collectable item obtainable from exploration/salvage
- A Structure to produce the food items.
- A Structure to consume the food items and provide stability bonus
- A simple supply chain

Why this mod exists
Hi, I just found the sector is a bit unlively without much description about daily life and culture.
So I decided to add some commodities to make the gameplay more immersive. (Just a bit!)

AI usage
Coding: Deepseek v4.1 Flash 1017
Artwork: ChatGPT 5.6 Luna

Mod compatibility
No game file is modified, so shouldn't be incompatible with any mods.

Changelog
0.2:
- Central Kitchen
- Output scales with colony size. Base output is divided by 1.5 (1.8 for the lobster dish), and ingredient demand is scaled by the same multiplier.
- The specialty is fixed when the industry is created and stored in the save, so a captured market keeps producing what its kitchen was built to make.
- Seeded automatically on NPC markets. Once per save.
- Removed the old size 6+ "imports other factions' specialties" demand from the Central Kitchen; the Consumer Market handles demand now.
- Consumer Market
- New structure representing the demand side of things
- Automatically created on existing colonies at first load and on new colonies the moment they are founded.
- Demand scales with market size
- Consumer Market grants stability while its demand is met: +1 for the four faction foods, +2 if the lobster dish is available.
- Spelling fix

0.1: Initial release

This is my first mod, feedbacks are welcomed!
